subject: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@fintechlabs.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options

Hi Chloe,

Quick note from our side — the team pushed more realistic traffic through the trial yesterday and we burned through the last of the test credits faster than expected. We have a concentrated set of prompts that need an extra 10–14 days to validate latency and multi-user load.

Two questions: can Redwood provide a short top-up (credits) for another 2 weeks, or alternatively a short time-boxed extension (14 days) at a flat rate? Procurement will also ask for a simple SOW/delivery note.

I attached the usage CSV from the last 48 hours that shows the spike. We prefer the top-up if it keeps things flexible, but if there’s a discount for the short fixed-term extension we’re open to that too.

Procurement: procurement@fintechlabs.com

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

— Emma Liu
Director, Platform Engineering
FinTech Labs
From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@fintechlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:08:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the heads-up and the usage file, that’s helpful. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Tessa (CS) to put together options.

High-level: we can do either a credits top-up (pay-as-you-go) or a short prepaid time-box at a fixed price. The tradeoffs are: credits keep conversion flexible but are slightly higher unit cost; time-box gives you predictable runway and a small discount for committing to reserved capacity for the 2-week window.

Marissa/Tessa — can you propose two succinct options and include what happens if they convert to a committed package after the trial (credit conversion policy)? Emma — we can have a draft SOW ready by EOD tomorrow once you confirm procurement contact.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Emma Liu <emma@fintechlabs.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T12:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options

Hi all —

Per Chloe’s ask, two clear options below based on the usage pattern in Emma’s CSV:

Option 1 — Credit Top-up (Recommended for flexibility)
- 200k token credit bundle (valid 30 days)
- Price: $2,400 (equivalent $0.012/token in this bundle)
- Credits applied immediately; unused credits expire after 30 days
- Conversion: if customer converts to a 3-month reserved commit within 30 days, 70% of unused credits are applied to the first invoice as a one-time billable credit

Option 2 — 14-day Time-box Extension (Predictable runway)
- Fixed-rate extension for 14 days of equivalent capacity (same SLAs)
- Price: $3,000 (includes a 10% short-term extension discount vs pay-as-you-go estimates)
- Includes inclusion: dedicated fair-share capacity cushion, priority scheduling for burst windows
- Conversion: if converted to a 3-month reserved commit within 14 days, Redwood applies a 50% credit of the extension fee to the first month

Notes:
- We can offer an additional 15% discount on either option if FinTech Labs signs a 3-month reserved commit within 10 business days of the extension start.
- Attached: Redwood_Shortburst_Pricing_v1.pdf (line-item breakdown) and a draft SOW skeleton.

Emma — which direction do you prefer? If procurement wants a PO, we can accept a short PO for the top-up or a one-off invoice for the time-box.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Liu <emma@fintechlabs.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T08:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options

Thanks Marissa — very clear. Procurement prefers a single fixed line item (simpler for PO). Two quick asks:

1) Can you move the time-box price down to $2,600? We can issue a PO today for a 14-day extension at that price if you accept.
2) We need the draft SOW and a one-page acceptance statement for procurement to match to the PO. They also want standard data handling language included. CC’ing procurement for visibility (procurement@fintechlabs.com).

If you can get the SOW and the updated price, we’ll push this through today.

— Emma
(On behalf of FinTech Labs)
From: chloe_martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@fintechlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, procurement@fintechlabs.com
Date: 2026-09-20T15:04:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Short evaluation: request for extra runtime & pricing options

Emma — happy to confirm.

We will accept the 14-day time-box at $2,600 under these conditions:
- Redwood will provide the 14-day extension starting once we receive the PO or payment confirmation.
- Redwood will include the one-page acceptance and the data handling clause you flagged (we’ll add the standard KMS/HSM and SOC 2 language to the SOW).
- As agreed, if FinTech Labs signs a 3-month reserved commit within 10 business days after the extension start, Redwood will apply a 15% discount credit toward the first month of the reserved commit.

Attachments: SOW-draft-FinTechLabs.docx (draft SOW with data handling language); Redwood_Shortburst_Pricing_v1.pdf (updated line item reflecting $2,600). DocuSign link to expedited statement will follow if you want signatures.

Next steps: Emma, please send the PO to finance@redwood.com and confirm the requested extension start date. We’ll provision the time-box the same business day we have the PO.

Thanks and looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Solutions — Redwood Inference
